fusion.weights: twice the branch softmax; final weights and biases zero at initialization

factorial.inference: per-seed and equal-weight seed mean, 95% paired acquisition-group bootstrap
factorial.extension: A/B/E held-out results were already known before enrolling C/D; validation selection is fixed before C/D test evaluation

validation.selection: native one-to-one mAP50-95 at 480, earliest best

quality.ap: 101-point interpolated precision; IoU 0.50 to 0.95 step 0.05; confidence-descending same-class greedy matching

openvino_exports.identity: XML and BIN SHA-256 plus checkpoint, head, precision and side
openvino_exports.before_timing: Reopen IR, verify actual input and output shapes, learned P3/P4/P5 box and class branches, top-k, and graph NMS count
openvino_exports.shared_row: Same 480 one-to-one bundle for resolution and head comparisons

deployment.tie: observed p95 session ranges intersect the fastest eligible artifact; prefer A for architecture and the smaller side for resolution

timing.core_policy: one logical processor on each of four performance cores
timing.primary: median of three session p95 values
timing.saving: dense minus one-to-one within session; median signed difference and median signed percent

uncertainty.seeds: retain individual estimates; use same resampled groups for all paired seeds
